name: Newsletter & Preferences

navigation.notes: **Reached from GST-039** — a preference is a setting on the profile. Stated on 4 September: this screen exited somewhere and nothing exited to it, so it was outside the navigation graph entirely.

transitions.provenance: derived — GST-001 declares entryState.params  and GST-065 holds none of them. The edge carries nothing: GST-001 needs nothing to open

notes: Added 17 August for parity with WEB-027. **Not on the wireframe board** — needs drawing. CF-93.
patternReason: `listConsentPurposes` reads a population and nothing reads one of them; the detail is the row until a `get` exists
purpose: What we may send you, and how.

components.label: What we may send you
components.notes: One row per configured purpose (`listConsentPurposes`), its channels as toggles, its plain-language description and the notice version in force; the current position from `getGuestConsents` (Given with date, Withdrawn with date, Not asked, Needs renewing). A change is recorded at once with `recordConsent` (source and notice version set by the app; the guest never types a purpose, decision, source or time). Withdrawing is as easy as giving.

components.label: Purposes and notices
components.notes: The configured purposes with their plain-language description, channels and the notice version in force.

components.label: Consent toggle
components.notes: Per purpose and channel; recorded at once on change, append-only.

components.label: Lists I receive
components.notes: One row per list with a toggle per channel; a channel can be switched on only where marketing consent for it is given, otherwise the toggle asks "Allow offers by email?" first and records the consent in the same act. The guest never types an id, a subject, a token or a list name.

components.label: Channel toggle
components.notes: The per-list, per-channel toggle; saved on change.

components.label: Stop all marketing
components.notes: Records withdrawn for the marketing purpose on every channel; every list shows paused; tickets and receipts still arrive.

states.error: Could not load. Names which read failed and leaves the newsletter preferences untouched.
states.emptyFirstRun: No newsletter preferences yet. Offers Record consent (`recordConsent`).
states.emptyNoResults: Never shown: `listConsentPurposes` takes no filter, so an empty list is always the first-run state above.
states.emptyNoAccess: **There is no permission to name — a guest holds none** (ADR-0025: `x-ticvai-permission` is what a staff caller must hold; a guest call resolves to the guest's own data; decided by Chinmay, fix before Block A starts, 2 October 2026 (GFIX-4)). No access here means one of two things, told apart by the response: not signed in, where the guest is offered sign-in and brought back to this screen, or a record that is not theirs, which says so without saying whose it is. **Never an empty table** — that reads as *there is no data* and sends somebody to support with the wrong question.
states.offline: **Not available, and the offline banner says why.** A consent change must reach the server to mean anything.

apisNote: Rebuilt 9 September 2026 from the 2 operations this screen declares, not from a workshop pack — it has none. Columns narrowed on 3 October 2026 to the fields the screen is about (CHG-SPF-002): at most five on a phone or handheld, plumbing and foreign ids left to the record itself.

offlineBanner.message: You're offline. Connect to the internet to book, pay, order or join a queue.
offlineBanner.shows: The moment the connection drops, on every screen, above the screen's own content.
offlineBanner.clears: By itself as soon as the connection is back, with a short "Back online" confirmation.
offlineBanner.never: Covers what is already on screen, or appears for a server error — that is the screen's own error state, and a guest told they are offline when the venue is down reconnects for nothing.
offlineBanner.provenance: Decided 12 September 2026 — guest web and guest app behave identically offline and say so with the same banner.

targetApp.name: TICVAI Guest
